guidance.promptSnippet: Clarify ambiguous requirements via ask_user_question. Every question object MUST have a `header` field (≤16 chars). Hard limits: 1-4 questions, 2-4 options per question, label ≤60 chars.
promptGuidelines: Batch all clarifications into one call (1-4 questions) instead of guessing.
Every question MUST include a required `header` (≤16 chars, e.g. 'Auth method') plus a `question` (full sentence ending in '?').
options: 2-4 per question; label ≤60 chars (1-5 words) + description. Reserved labels — never author: 'Other', 'Type something.', 'Next'.
multiSelect: true for non-exclusive choices. preview: single-select only, for comparing mockups/code/configs. Recommended option first, label suffixed '(Recommended)'.
